scope: Two CPU-time-weighted i386 stack captures in the live headless raid. FPS values describe instrumented windows.
profiler_thread_selection: Hottest guest thread per preceding period
caller_validation: Aligned increasing EBP chain within 2 MiB of guest ESP, at most 16 frames. Accept the prefix through return PCs decoded as ends of i386 call instructions in the client text.
cpu_denominator: All CPU-time-weighted samples in the GPU measurement window, including host and untranslated samples.
inclusive_counter_semantics: Count a detected unwind entry once per sample, including when it repeats recursively. Leaf and caller without an unwind match still contribute to the CPU denominator.
